$schema_note: Enumeracao das ~20 ultimas versoes de cada driver por linguagem, com compatibilidade agrupada (compat_group) e veredito de upgrade. Complementa driver-compat-matrix.json com profundidade de versao para validar drivers antigos.

meta.scope: Ultimas ~20 versoes lancadas de cada driver (Java/Go/Python/Node) das familias RDS/Aurora (Postgres, MySQL/MariaDB, Oracle), ElastiCache (Redis/Valkey) e DynamoDB/DocumentDB.
meta.how_to_read: Cada driver tem compat_groups (atributos de compatibilidade definidos 1x por grupo) e versions[] (as ~20 ultimas, mais novas primeiro, cada uma apontando um group). Datas = registry real (Maven/PyPI/npm/GitHub/goproxy).
meta.honesty_note: Numeros de versao e datas sao reais (puxados dos registries). Campos de compatibilidade marcados 'unverified' nao foram confirmados na fonte; principais: valkey-py server matrix, floors de runtime em linhas de dev, channel_binding do asyncpg/postgres.js.

G2.notes: 42.5.3-42.7.3: SCRAM + channel binding present. PG17 protocol-compatible but not explicitly verified at release.

SCRAM since v1.1.0 (2018); every listed version survives md5->scram. No channel binding. Maintenance mode; PG17 protocol-compatible/unverified.

2.9.10+ dropped Python<3.8. SCRAM works only if bundled/linked libpq>=10; psycopg2-binary wheels ship recent libpq; source builds inherit system libpq. channel_binding needs libpq>=13. Package version does NOT determine SCRAM.

G2.notes: 2.9-2.9.9. SCRAM entirely governed by linked libpq. PG17 unverified.

G3.notes: 2.8.x EOL-era. Old wheels may bundle libpq predating SCRAM; verify libpq at runtime.

0.31.0 drops Python 3.8. SCRAM since 0.11. Channel binding historically not implemented; status unverified.
8.x implements SASL/SCRAM in JS (since 8.0) so works vs SCRAM-default PG14+ regardless of libpq. Channel binding not implemented.
3.x implements SASL/SCRAM in pure JS. Channel binding unverified. PG17 not release-verified but no protocol blocker.
